steps.title: Name the owner
steps.body: Assign a project lead and supporting experts for the candidate agent.

steps.title: Baseline it
steps.body: Document the current process including the performance numbers that will later show success.

steps.title: Design the future state
steps.body: Plan how the process changes with the agent in place, including expected improvements and business benefit.

steps.title: Plan the build
steps.body: Cover scope, key dates, success measures, and security and data compliance checks.
